basic_details.job_title: RAILTEL Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for Chief Manager / Senior Manager Posts
basic_details.short_information: RailTel Corporation of India Ltd (RAILTEL) has released the RAILTEL Chief Manager / Sr. Manager Recruitment 2026 notification for 1 vacancy on a deputation basis. Eligible candidates working in the specified Railway grades can submit their offline applications for the Chief Manager (E3) / Sr. Manager (E3) post. The maximum age limit is 56 years for deputation and below 62 years for re-employment. The last date to submit the application is 21 November 2026. Candidates can check the official notification PDF and application details below.

application_fee.details: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification.

age_limit.age_details: Deputation: Not exceeding 56 years; Re-employment: Below 62 years
age_limit.details: All Posts: Maximum age limit is 56 years for deputation and below 62 years for re-employment as on the closing date of receipt of application.

qualification.education_qualification: Junior Scale (Level-10-CDA) or Group 'B' (Level-9/Level-8) for Chief Manager; SSE working in Level 9/Level 8 for Sr. Manager
qualification.details: Chief Manager (E3): Working in Railways Junior Scale (Level-10-CDA) or Group 'B' (Level-9/Level 8) Sr. Manager (E3): SSE working in Level 9/Level 8

salary_details.pay_scale: Parent Grade Pay plus Deputation Allowance or DPE Scales and Allowances
salary_details.details: Parent grade pay plus deputation allowance or DPE scales and allowances

selection_process: Application through proper channel Screening and selection as per RailTel terms and conditions
how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for RAILTEL Chief Manager / Sr. Manager Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: WWW.RAILTEL.IN.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 21-11-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by RailTel Corporation of India Ltd (RAILTEL) for filling up vacant posts through deputation or re-employment basis.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in this recruitment notification?
faq.answer: The notification invites applications for the positions of Chief Manager and Sr. Manager under the S&T executive category from railways.

faq.question: Q3. What is the total number of vacancies announced?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Chief Manager / Sr. Manager position in this recruitment cycle.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for RAILTEL Recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit their applications through offline mode by sending the filled form via post through the proper channel.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to submit the offline application form?
faq.answer: The last date for the receipt of completed offline applications is 21 November 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the required educational qualification for Chief Manager?
faq.answer: Candidates must be working in Railways Junior Scale (Level-10-CDA) or Group 'B' (Level-9/Level 8) to apply for the Chief Manager post.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for applying to these positions?
faq.answer: For deputation, the maximum age is not exceeding 56 years, and for re-employment, candidates should be below 62 years as on the closing date.

faq.question: Q8. Where should the completed application form be sent?
faq.answer: Applications should be sent by post through the proper channel to Corporate Office/RCIL, East Kidwai Nagar, New Delhi - 110023.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee required for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee has been specified in the official notification for submitting the offline application form.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I download the official notification PDF and application form?
faq.answer: You can download the official notification and application details by visiting the official website at WWW.RAILTEL.IN.
